title: The 'temperamental' stigma and how it hurt her
summary: Dance and Norvo discuss how the label followed Mildred and let others blame her for bad results, though Hammond and musicians knew better.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press
